_note: Copy to config.json (gitignored) only to change a default. Defaults: roots = the repo and its VRG-DE parent; browser = the first of START.cmd's portable browsers (Planner/apps chrome, opera-gx, zen-browser), else the system default; terminal = wt when installed, else cmd; claudeCmd = Planner/apps/node/claude.cmd, else claude; vscode = Planner/apps/vscode/Code.exe, else code; git = Planner/apps/git, else git.
